response.sql: SELECT city_id, address_count, address_count / AVG(address_count) OVER () AS count_divided_by_city_average, address_count / SUM(address_count) OVER () AS share_of_all_addresses FROM (SELECT city_id, COUNT(*) AS address_count FROM address GROUP BY city_id) AS city_counts ORDER BY share_of_all_addresses DESC LIMIT 10
